items.text: The game has been updated to address some of the issues that we have already posted about on the discussion board.

The game was launching with the Japanese language after the first launch. This should be fixed on the latest build. If you have not encountered this problem, you don't need to do anything. If you have encountered this problem already, you will want to adjust the Language in the Options menu, and it shouldn't happen again moving forward.
Select the second option from the top to open the Options Menu.
Select the fourth option from the top to open the Languages Menu.
Select the top drop down, and select your desired language.

Additionally, people were having issue with Steam Cloud when switching devices. This was caused by the Japanese language issue above. To resolve the issue, you will just need to switch languages in game as mentioned above, and the Steam Cloud won't have any issues between devices. You will likely need to adjust the language on the original device you first played the game on, after that it should be fixed moving forward.

Lastly, there were reports of controllers not working for some people. Additional checks have been added to catch more types of controllers. For the non-standard controller types, they should be treated as the closest approximation of the standard models.
